reviews.title: One space Quadro card with RTX perks
reviews.comment: I edit videos often.  This card seemed perfect for my purposes.  The bonus is that it only takes up one slot!  The reviews show it comparable to a RTX 3070.  This seems to be the case in my experience.  My 4K monitor has DP ports, so I did not need an adapter for the video signal.  I picked up some active 4K HDMI adapters just in case.
reviews.author: Tech Guy

reviews.title: Used not New
reviews.comment: Not new.  Not PNY.  Removed from a Dell system and passed off as a new card.  Wasn't even packaged in a proper sized anti static bag
reviews.author: Concepts

reviews.title: Does not come in original product packaging-Appears to be a used card.
reviews.comment: Part came with a plain box, does not look new, the lower bracket was bent, had to bend it back to install it.  This appears to be a used/refurbished product being sold as new.  It only has a 30 day warranty on it as well, seems like it should have come in the original packaging instead of a brown box with bubble wrap around it?
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Great card for AI, does very well for a gaming card as well.
reviews.comment: I have it running CUDA under WSL. With 16GB of VRAM, you can fit Llama2-13B Q6 100% in ram, and it generates text far faster than you can read. It's kind of a sweet spot for language models. It also plays games pretty games pretty well, and has ECC memory. Definitely a good buy.
reviews.author: Jem

reviews.title: Very capable video card with a poorly designed heatsink that quickly plugs up with dust .
reviews.comment: This card is very capable . However once you have owned one for a while you will run into the problem of rising GPU temperatures . This card runs hot . The factory cooler was designed with compactness as priority #1 . The factory heatsink will quickly plug with dust and you will notice your performance slowing down as the card throttles . I installed 3rd party cooler that I bought on Ebay for $75 . For the kind of money they want for these cards it's sad to have to do this .
reviews.author: ronald a champagne
